# UC-MUSE1 — Your agent, our gateway (external agent, standard lane)

**Track:** tools  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Customers already run their own agents — Muse, Grok, LM Studio, LibreChat, ChatGPT — and want to use them against their bank without handing over credentials or losing protection.

## PingOne Solution

The agent connects to the bank’s MCP external door: RFC 9728 discovery, RFC 7591 DCR self-registration, PKCE login in the user’s browser, then a delegated token (sub=user, act=agent) through PingGateway and PingOne Authorize on every tool call.

## How to Run

## What to Say

> Point your own agent at the bank’s MCP endpoint and watch Ping govern it: the agent onboards itself (discovery, DCR, PKCE login) and every call runs with a delegated token — sub=user, act=agent — audited end to end.
